ia.description_en: Arabic audio recording of Umdat al-Ahkam (عمدة الأحكام) by Imam Abd al-Ghani al-Maqdisi (d. 600 AH), a compact collection of 414 hadith from the two Sahih collections on the rulings of worship and daily life, read by Amr al-Basati. The recording is a single track of about 2 hours 50 minutes.
